quote_original: When we meet we do not purposely walk on the opposite side of the street, but it is almost a cold meeting because we have nothing to discuss.
context_before: For ten years I was a dancer, dancing in Broadway shows, in vaudeville, night clubs, and in Europe. There was a time in my life when I thought I could not live without certain friends in my world. I would spread a table every night after the theatre and we would all dine well. I thought I could never live without them. Now I confess I could not live with them. We have nothing in common today.
context_after: I so died to that life that as I meet these people they cannot even talk of the old times.
selection_note: Key statement from Lesson 1: Consciousness Is The Only Reality of the 1948 Master Class series.
